Question Choices: Round 8921 to the nearest 10. What number do you get?
Hints: Is the ones digit 5 or more?
Solution: 8921 is between 8920 and 8930 and is only 1 from 8920. Round to 8920.

Question Choices: Round 2486 to the nearest 100. What number do you get?
Solution: 2486 is above the midpoint 2450 between 2400 and 2500. Round to 2500.

Question Choices: Round 888 to the nearest 100. What number do you get?
Solution: 888 is above the midpoint 850 between 800 and 900. Round to 900.

Question Choices: Fill: Round 129 to the nearest 10 is __ and to the nearest 100 is __
Hints: Two answers. Is the ones digit 5 or more? Is the tens digit 5 or more?
Solution: 129 is 1 below 130, so to tens it rounds to 130. It is below the midpoint 150, so to hundreds it rounds to 100. Fill 130, 100.

Question Choices: Fill: Round 7215 to the nearest 1000 is __. Round 6930 to the nearest 1000 is __
Solution: 7215 is below 7500, so it rounds to 7000. 6930 is above 6500, so it also rounds to 7000. Fill 7000, 7000.
